features.title: Metadata Header
features.desc: YAML-based header for title, description, OG tags, CSS imports, alignment, and gradient colors.

features.title: Unicode Escapes
features.desc: Supports \uXXXX, \u{X+}, and \xNN escape sequences anywhere in text.

features.title: Gradient Text
features.desc: Use ==text== syntax with configurable gradient_colors in the header.

features.title: Formatting
features.desc: Bold, italic, underline, inline code, links, images — full markdown style.

features.title: Code Blocks
features.desc: Syntax-highlighted blocks with optional +templating mode for placeholder injection.

features.title: Alerts
features.desc: GitHub-style NOTE, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING, and CAUTION blockquotes.

features.title: Iterators
features.desc: Loop over arrays with $iterate list as var{ ... } syntax, supports nesting.

features.title: Placeholders
features.desc: Inject JSON data via stdin with ${path.to.value} syntax.

features.title: Open Graph
features.desc: Automatic og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:site_name, twitter:card.

features.title: Alignment
features.desc: Control page layout with align: center (default), left, or right.
